query: 測試跨午夜額度邏輯，要改 OS 時間還是注入 clock？

candidates.title: 2026-10-15 - now() is the transaction start; age and window gates need clock_timestamp()
candidates.summary: In PostgreSQL `now()` / `current_timestamp` is frozen at transaction start; a holder of an old open transaction can back-date any timestamp the routine writes with it, so minimum-age and reset-window gates must stamp with `clock_timestamp()`.

candidates.title: 2026-07-23 — Injectable wall clock for day-boundary logic
candidates.summary: Time-dependent business logic (local day, near-midnight windows, quotas) must take an injectable clock or explicit `Instant`/`LocalDate` parameters; tests freeze that clock instead of changing the OS date.
